messages:
alex: Quick signal 1: we're targeting a narrowwave tonight for runtime v2.5 (kernel batching) + router header-split. Need to coordinate API schema minor bump and console UI flag. Change window 01:30-03:00 UTC. tagging @rachel @tom @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: deploybot: wave reservation done: wave=20250401-0130. Please run /preflight and pin before start.

rachel: FYI the API minor bump is strictly additive (opt-in field) but requires router to surface new header for routing-by-model. No DB changes.

tom: Two risks: 1) KV cache shape changes in runtime could break warm-starts. 2) router header-split could cause misrouted dev traffic if older clients don't send header. My recommendation: pin runtime+router first, leave api unpinned until 25% stage, console behind feature flag.

priya: Ops note: our canary rollback window needs a fast path. I'll prepare a one-liner to drain traffic and unpin variants. Suggested triggers: 5xx rate > 2.5x baseline OR model-serve error spikes OR sustained p99 CPU > 90% for >2 minutes. If triggered, plan: traffic->0% in 60s, unpin runtime, rollback runtime to v2.4.

sree: I'll provision temporary telemetry dashboards and add an alert for model-serve-errors and memory delta. Also add a short-lived SLO annotation so paging only for Sev2+

alex: Proposed rollout timeline: pin runtime+router -> 5% (15m) -> 20% (15m) -> 50% (20m) -> 100% if green. API pin at 20% step. Console flag can be enabled gradually via rollout toggle (no pin).

rachel: Agree. For the console, we'll enable UI flag at 20% and keep a client-negotiation shim for headerless sessions for 24h. If too noisy, flip flag off.

tom: Preflight party: staging smoke, mixed client test, headerless fallback test, long-session memory soak for 30m. I'll run the soak at 19:00 PT and post results.

deploy-bot: deploybot: preflight run queued: 1720498800-staging-rt-v2.5-smoke. Please attach logs if anything fails.

priya: Quick ops checklist: health probes green \u2705, grpc timeout sanity \u2705, kv-eviction thresholds checked \u2705, rollback script tested \u2705. Rollback script: ```/ops/rollback-wave --wave=20250401-0130 --component=runtime --target=v2.4```

alex: We also need a documented pin grant list. Who has permission to /pin for this wave?

rachel: I'll grant pin to alex, tom, priya for the runtime and router. API pin to me + alex. Console flag controlled by product (me).

sree: Staging soak: memory trend stable, no leak observed in 30m run. Recorded as 1720499400-staging-soak-v2.5.

priya: Ops will stand by in #oncall during the window. I'll set short L1 runbook: immediate unpin + traffic 0% if mem+error triggers fire.

alex: Final ask: anyone object to leaving console unpinned and using feature flag? We want minimal pin churn for UX teams.

tom: No objection from runtime engineering, as long as shim stays enabled for headerless clients for the first 24h.

rachel: Product OK with gradual flag. I'll post a 2-sentence release blurb to #release-notes after this thread.

alex: Good. When we go live: run these exact commands at start of wave:
```
/pin runtime v2.5 --wave=20250401-0130
/pin router v2.5 --wave=20250401-0130
# wait for 5% confirmation then:
/pin api v2.5 --wave=20250401-0130  # at 20% stage
# console: toggle feature flag via prod-rollout console_header_split=true
```

priya: I'll also have the rollback command ready in the ops channel: 
```
/ops/rollback-wave --wave=20250401-0130 --component=runtime --target=v2.4 --drain-seconds=60
```

alex: Thanks team. If staging soak looks good at 19:00 PT we'll proceed. I'll post a start update here once I /start-wave.

(automated) deploy-bot: deploybot: wave metadata attached: wave=20250401-0130, owner=alex, pins_required=[runtime,router,api], change_window=01:30-03:00 UTC.

priya: Ops note: set temporary mute on non-actionable perf alerts, keep critical errors loud.

alex: Closing. We'll reconvene in-thread during the wave for live status.
